$comment: ADR-226 §1.1 (B-1759): the reviewed OpenCode 1.19.5 tool registry, from the stage-0 run (__tests__/fixtures/opencode-stage0/stage0-evidence.json, items 3 and 4) and the tool schemas of the installed binary. `fields`: every argument the adapter (opencode-claude-tools.js) reads, with its JSON type. `ignored`: the other declared properties, each reviewed as unable to change what or where the tool touches (bash timeout; read offset/limit: range of the same file; webfetch format/timeout; websearch result count/crawl/type/size; task task_id: resumes a subagent session whose calls are gated the same way; task command: free text naming the trigger). A field outside fields + ignored is denied per call (stage 0: glob/grep/todowrite accept unknown extra fields). A tool absent here is denied (custom tools, tools added by other plugins, lsp/plan/execute/batch/list/multiedit). `question` maps to AskUserQuestion and is always denied (`run` has no answer channel). MCP tools (`<server>_<tool>`) are not listed: their schema comes from the server.
